tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Identify the account, user, and credential behind this connection, with plan, credit balance, rate limits, and the tools available. Only needed to troubleshoot the connection or check credits and limits — other tools already act on this account.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List what a script can call: the Crevio API (crevioApi), Crevio's own tools (platform), and every integration you can use, each as a namespace under `tools`, plus the account's other connected apps and their status. Then list a namespace's functions with list_integration_tools.

tools.name: list_integration_tools
tools.description: List one namespace's functions — the name a script calls, its parameters, whether it only reads, whether it needs approval, and a snippet run_script accepts. crevioApi has hundreds of operations: narrow it with `search`.

tools.name: run_script
tools.description: Run JavaScript on the account's computer with bun — no agent turn — and wait for its result. `tools.<namespace>.<function>(args)` calls anything list_integration_tools shows (every call returns its result and throws on failure; top-level await works), and the script's last expression is its result.

tools.name: wait_for_script_run
tools.description: Wait for a script run to finish and return its result. If it is still running when the wait ends, the reply has wait_timed_out: true — call again.

tools.name: get_script_run
tools.description: Read a script run's status, and its result once it has finished.

tools.name: cancel_script_run
tools.description: Cancel a script run that has not started yet. A running script runs to its end or its timeout.

tools.name: ask_crevio
tools.description: Delegate a job to the Crevio agent and wait for the result. The agent works your account through the Crevio API and every connected integration (products, customers, orders, email, socials, sites, research) and replies in `result`. Each job is a full agent run that takes from half a minute to severa

tools.name: start_chat
tools.description: Open a chat with the Crevio agent and queue a run, without waiting. Returns the run immediately — its `chat_id` is the conversation to continue with send_message. Follow the run with wait_for_run or get_run.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List the account's chats, newest first.

tools.name: get_chat
tools.description: Get a chat's title, kind, and latest run.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Continue a chat with follow-up instructions or answers — the agent keeps its context. Resumes a run waiting in needs_input, or queues a new run when the last one finished. Returns run_busy while a run is still in progress. Optionally waits for the reply.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Read a chat's messages, oldest first. Returns the most recent `limit` messages; page back through older ones with starting_after.

tools.name: wait_for_run
tools.description: Wait for a run to settle (completed, failed, or needs_input) and return it with the agent's final reply. If it is still running when the wait ends, the reply has wait_timed_out: true — call wait_for_run again.

tools.name: get_run
tools.description: Fetch a run's current status, summary, pending approvals, and (once settled) the agent's final reply.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List the account's task runs, newest first — delegated jobs and scheduled tasks alike. Filter by status or task.

tools.name: resolve_approvals
tools.description: Approve or deny the integration actions a run is paused on (status needs_input with pending_approval_ids). Submit a decision for every pending id at once; the run resumes in the background.

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.description: Stop a run that is pending, running, or waiting for input. The run is finalized as failed with 'Cancelled by the caller'.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "run_script" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ask_crevio, start_chat, list_chats, get_chat, list_messages · Private data: whoami · Public sink: ask_crevio, send_message, resolve_approvals · Destructive: run_script, wait_for_script_run, get_script_run, cancel_script_run, ask_crevio, start_chat, get_chat, send_message, wait_for_run, get_run, resolve_approvals, cancel_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ask_crevio, start_chat, list_chats, get_chat, list_messages · Private data: whoami · Public sink: ask_crevio, send_message, resolve_approvals · Destructive: run_script, wait_for_script_run, get_script_run, cancel_script_run, ask_crevio, start_chat, get_chat, send_message, wait_for_run, get_run, resolve_approvals, cancel_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "whoami" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
